node --input-type=module -e 'import {outerReach as c} from "./server/course/outer-reach.mjs"; import {briefing} from "./server/voyage/briefing.mjs"; import {parseDrill} from "./server/course/exercises.mjs"; import {plan} from "./server/voyage/plan.mjs"; const go=lane=>({kind:"sail",lane}); const k=kind=>({kind}); const pre=[go("west"),k("tune"),k("wait"),go("crossing"),k("tune")]; const a=parseDrill("ridge-return:a"); const b=parseDrill("ridge-return:b"); const at7=briefing(c,pre,a); if(at7.state.tick!==7||at7.state.power!==3||!at7.state.lit.includes("skerry"))process.exit(1); if(briefing(c,[...pre,go("creek")],a).rejected?.code!=="tide")process.exit(1); const p=plan(c,at7.state,11,a); if(!p.guarantee||p.common[0]?.kind!=="wait"||p.branches.a.finish!==10||p.branches.b.finish!==11)process.exit(1); if(JSON.stringify(plan(c,briefing(c,pre,b).state,11,b))!==JSON.stringify(p))process.exit(1); const late={ex:{...a.ex,announce:9},actual:"a"}; if(plan(c,at7.state,11,late).guarantee)process.exit(1); const A=briefing(c,[...pre,k("wait"),...p.branches.a.actions],a); const B=briefing(c,[...pre,k("wait"),...p.branches.b.actions],b); if(!A.score.won||A.state.tick!==10||!B.score.won||B.state.tick!==11)process.exit(1); console.log(p.branches.a.finish, p.branches.b.finish);'
